**三、Verilog 代码（my_cpu.v）**

```verilog
module my_cpu(
    input clk,
    input rst,
    output reg [5:0] led
);
    reg [7:0] pc;                // 程序计数器
    reg [15:0] ir;               // 指令寄存器
    reg [7:0] regs [0:15];       // R0-R15
    reg [7:0] sp;                // 栈指针
    reg zero_flag;               // 零标志
    reg carry_flag;              // 进位/借位标志
    reg [15:0] prog_mem [0:255]; // 程序内存
    reg [7:0] data_mem [0:255];  // 数据内存（兼栈区）
    reg [1:0] state;

    wire [3:0] opcode = ir[15:12];
    wire [3:0] rd     = ir[11:8];
    wire [3:0] rs     = ir[7:4];
    wire [7:0] addr8  = ir[7:0];
    wire [3:0] imm4   = ir[3:0];

    integer i;

    initial begin
        // 程序内存清零
        for (i = 0; i < 256; i = i + 1)
            prog_mem[i] = 16'h0000;

        // 数据内存清零
        for (i = 0; i < 256; i = i + 1)
            data_mem[i] = 8'h00;

        // ===== 主程序 =====
        prog_mem[0] = 16'h1605; // MOV R6, #5    ; R6 = 5
        prog_mem[1] = 16'hB020; // CALL 0x20     ; 调用 sum
        prog_mem[2] = 16'hF600; // OUT R6        ; 显示结果
        prog_mem[3] = 16'h0000; // HALT

        // ===== 子程序 sum（地址 0x20 = 32）=====
        prog_mem[32] = 16'h1700; // MOV R7, #0    ; R7 = 0
        prog_mem[33] = 16'h7670; // CMP R6, R7    ; 比较 R6 和 0
        prog_mem[34] = 16'h9029; // JZ 0x29       ; 若 R6==0，跳到 41
        prog_mem[35] = 16'hD600; // PUSH R6       ; 保存 n
        prog_mem[36] = 16'h5610; // SUB R6, #1    ; n = n - 1
        prog_mem[37] = 16'hB020; // CALL 0x20     ; 递归调用 sum(n-1)
        prog_mem[38] = 16'hE700; // POP R7        ; 恢复 n 到 R7
        prog_mem[39] = 16'h4670; // ADD R6, R7    ; R6 = sum(n-1) + n
        prog_mem[40] = 16'hC000; // RET
        prog_mem[41] = 16'h1600; // MOV R6, #0    ; sum(0) = 0
        prog_mem[42] = 16'hC000; // RET
    end

    always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
        if (rst) begin
            pc <= 0;
            sp <= 8'hFF;
            state <= 0;
            zero_flag <= 0;
            carry_flag <= 0;
            for (i = 0; i < 16; i = i + 1)
                regs[i] <= 0;
            led <= 0;
        end else begin
            case (state)
                0: begin // 取指
                    ir <= prog_mem[pc];
                    state <= 1;
                end
                1: begin // 译码 + 执行
                    case (opcode)
                        4'h0: begin // HALT
                            led <= regs[6][5:0];
                            state <= 2;
                        end
                        4'h1: begin // MOV Rd, #imm4
                            regs[rd] <= {4'b0, imm4};
                            pc <= pc + 1; state <= 0;
                        end
                        4'h2: begin // MOV Rd, Rs
                            regs[rd] <= regs[rs];
                            pc <= pc + 1; state <= 0;
                        end
                        4'h3: begin // ADD Rd, #imm4
                            regs[rd] <= regs[rd] + {4'b0, imm4};
                            zero_flag <= (regs[rd] + {4'b0, imm4}) == 0;
                            carry_flag <= (regs[rd] + {4'b0, imm4}) > 255;
                            pc <= pc + 1; state <= 0;
                        end
                        4'h4: begin // ADD Rd, Rs
                            regs[rd] <= regs[rd] + regs[rs];
                            zero_flag <= (regs[rd] + regs[rs]) == 0;
                            carry_flag <= (regs[rd] + regs[rs]) > 255;
                            pc <= pc + 1; state <= 0;
                        end
                        4'h5: begin // SUB Rd, #imm4
                            regs[rd] <= regs[rd] - {4'b0, imm4};
                            zero_flag <= (regs[rd] - {4'b0, imm4}) == 0;
                            carry_flag <= (regs[rd] < {4'b0, imm4});
                            pc <= pc + 1; state <= 0;
                        end
                        4'h6: begin // SUB Rd, Rs
                            regs[rd] <= regs[rd] - regs[rs];
                            zero_flag <= (regs[rd] - regs[rs]) == 0;
                            carry_flag <= (regs[rd] < regs[rs]);
                            pc <= pc + 1; state <= 0;
                        end
                        4'h7: begin // CMP Rd, Rs
                            zero_flag <= (regs[rd] == regs[rs]);
                            carry_flag <= (regs[rd] < regs[rs]);
                            pc <= pc + 1; state <= 0;
                        end
                        4'h8: begin // JMP addr8
                            pc <= addr8; state <= 0;
                        end
                        4'h9: begin // JZ addr8
                            if (zero_flag) pc <= addr8;
                            else pc <= pc + 1;
                            state <= 0;
                        end
                        4'hA: begin // JNZ addr8
                            if (!zero_flag) pc <= addr8;
                            else pc <= pc + 1;
                            state <= 0;
                        end
                        4'hB: begin // CALL addr8
                            sp <= sp - 1;
                            data_mem[sp - 1] <= pc + 1;
                            pc <= addr8;
                            state <= 0;
                        end
                        4'hC: begin // RET
                            pc <= data_mem[sp];
                            sp <= sp + 1;
                            state <= 0;
                        end
                        4'hD: begin // PUSH Rd
                            sp <= sp - 1;
                            data_mem[sp - 1] <= regs[rd];
                            pc <= pc + 1; state <= 0;
                        end
                        4'hE: begin // POP Rd
                            regs[rd] <= data_mem[sp];
                            sp <= sp + 1;
                            pc <= pc + 1; state <= 0;
                        end
                        4'hF: begin // OUT Rd
                            led <= regs[rd][5:0];
                            pc <= pc + 1; state <= 0;
                        end
                    endcase
                end
                2: begin end // 停机
            endcase
        end
    end
endmodule
```

**六、换程序：斐波那契**

```verilog
// fib(0)=0, fib(1)=1, fib(n)=fib(n-1)+fib(n-2)
// 主程序：计算 fib(10) = 55
prog_mem[0] = 16'h160A; // MOV R6, #10
prog_mem[1] = 16'hB020; // CALL 0x20
prog_mem[2] = 16'hF600; // OUT R6
prog_mem[3] = 16'h0000; // HALT

// 子程序 fib（地址 0x20）
prog_mem[32] = 16'h1700; // MOV R7, #0
prog_mem[33] = 16'h7670; // CMP R6, R7
prog_mem[34] = 16'h9029; // JZ 0x29       ; fib(0)=0
prog_mem[35] = 16'h1710; // MOV R7, #1
prog_mem[36] = 16'h7670; // CMP R6, R7
prog_mem[37] = 16'h9030; // JZ 0x30       ; fib(1)=1
prog_mem[38] = 16'hD600; // PUSH R6
prog_mem[39] = 16'h5610; // SUB R6, #1
prog_mem[40] = 16'hB020; // CALL 0x20     ; fib(n-1)
prog_mem[41] = 16'hE700; // POP R7
prog_mem[42] = 16'hD700; // PUSH R7
prog_mem[43] = 16'hD600; // PUSH R6
prog_mem[44] = 16'h5710; // SUB R7, #1
prog_mem[45] = 16'hB020; // CALL 0x20     ; fib(n-2)
prog_mem[46] = 16'hE600; // POP R6
prog_mem[47] = 16'h4670; // ADD R6, R7    ; fib(n-1)+fib(n-2)
prog_mem[48] = 16'hC000; // RET
prog_mem[49] = 16'h1600; // MOV R6, #0    ; fib(0)=0
prog_mem[50] = 16'hC000; // RET
prog_mem[51] = 16'h1610; // MOV R6, #1    ; fib(1)=1
prog_mem[52] = 16'hC000; // RET
```

## 🤖 DeepSeek（deepseek） · 2026-10-03 17:12

好。给 CPU 加位运算和间接寻址。指令从 16 位扩到 32 位，现在能跑指针和数组了。

**一、新指令格式（32 位）**

| 位 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| 31-24 | 操作码 |
| 23-20 | Rd |
| 19-16 | Rs |
| 15-0 | 立即数 / 地址 |

**寄存器：** R0–R15（8 位）
**SP：** 栈指针，初值 0xFF
**标志：** Z（零）、C（进位/借位）、N（负）

**操作码：**

| 操作码 | 指令 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `0x00` | HALT | 停机，LED 显示 R6 |
| `0x01` | MOV Rd, #imm16 | Rd = imm16 |
| `0x02` | MOV Rd, Rs | Rd = Rs |
| `0x03` | ADD Rd, #imm16 | Rd += imm16，更新标志 |
| `0x04` | ADD Rd, Rs | Rd += Rs，更新标志 |
| `0x05` | SUB Rd, #imm16 | Rd -= imm16，更新标志 |
| `0x06` | SUB Rd, Rs | Rd -= Rs，更新标志 |
| `0x07` | CMP Rd, Rs | 比较，更新标志 |
| `0x08` | JMP addr16 | PC = addr16 |
| `0x09` | JZ addr16 | 若 Z=1，PC = addr16 |
| `0x0A` | JNZ addr16 | 若 Z=0，PC = addr16 |
| `0x0B` | CALL addr16 | 压入返回地址，跳到 addr16 |
| `0x0C` | RET | 弹出返回地址 |
| `0x0D` | PUSH Rd | 压栈 |
| `0x0E` | POP Rd | 出栈 |
| `0x0F` | OUT Rd | LED = Rd[5:0] |
| `0x10` | AND Rd, Rs | Rd &= Rs |
| `0x11` | OR Rd, Rs | Rd \|= Rs |
| `0x12` | XOR Rd, Rs | Rd ^= Rs |
| `0x13` | NOT Rd | Rd = ~Rd |
| `0x14` | SHL Rd, #imm4 | Rd <<= imm4 |
| `0x15` | SHR Rd, #imm4 | Rd >>= imm4 |
| `0x16` | LOADR Rd, Rs | Rd = data_mem[Rs] |
| `0x17` | STORER Rd, Rs | data_mem[Rs] = Rd |
| `0x18` | LOAD Rd, addr16 | Rd = data_mem[addr16] |
| `0x19` | STORE Rd, addr16 | data_mem[addr16] = Rd |
| `0x1A` | INC Rd | Rd++ |
| `0x1B` | DEC Rd | Rd-- |

---

**二、示例程序 1：数组求和**

把 5 个数存进内存，用指针遍历求和。

| 地址 | 机器码 | 汇编 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | `0x01200005` | `MOV R2, #5` | R2 = 5，数组长度 |
| 1 | `0x01300000` | `MOV R3, #0` | R3 = 0，和 |
| 2 | `0x01400010` | `MOV R4, #0x10` | R4 = 0x10，数组首地址 |
| 3 | `0x01500000` | `MOV R5, #0` | R5 = 0，循环计数 |
| 4 | `0x16240000` | `LOADR R2, R4` | R2 = data_mem[R4] |
| 5 | `0x04330000` | `ADD R3, R2` | R3 += R2 |
| 6 | `0x1A400000` | `INC R4` | R4++，指针后移 |
| 7 | `0x1A500000` | `INC R5` | R5++ |
| 8 | `0x07450000` | `CMP R5, R2` | 比较计数和长度 |
| 9 | `0x0A040000` | `JNZ 0x04` | 未遍历完，跳回 4 |
| 10 | `0x0F300000` | `OUT R3` | 显示和 |
| 11 | `0x00000000` | `HALT` | 停机 |

**数据区（地址 0x10 开始）：** 存 `1, 2, 3, 4, 5`，和为 15。

**三、Verilog 代码（my_cpu.v）**

```verilog
module my_cpu(
    input clk,
    input rst,
    output reg [5:0] led
);
    reg [7:0] pc;
    reg [31:0] ir;
    reg [7:0] regs [0:15];
    reg [7:0] sp;
    reg zero_flag, carry_flag, neg_flag;
    reg [31:0] prog_mem [0:255];
    reg [7:0] data_mem [0:255];
    reg [1:0] state;

    wire [7:0] opcode = ir[31:24];
    wire [3:0] rd     = ir[23:20];
    wire [3:0] rs     = ir[19:16];
    wire [15:0] imm16 = ir[15:0];
    wire [3:0] imm4   = ir[3:0];

    integer i;

    initial begin
        for (i = 0; i < 256; i = i + 1) begin
            prog_mem[i] = 32'h00000000;
            data_mem[i] = 8'h00;
        end

        // ===== 数组求和程序 =====
        prog_mem[0]  = 32'h01200005; // MOV R2, #5
        prog_mem[1]  = 32'h01300000; // MOV R3, #0
        prog_mem[2]  = 32'h01400010; // MOV R4, #0x10
        prog_mem[3]  = 32'h01500000; // MOV R5, #0
        prog_mem[4]  = 32'h16240000; // LOADR R2, R4
        prog_mem[5]  = 32'h04330000; // ADD R3, R2
        prog_mem[6]  = 32'h1A400000; // INC R4
        prog_mem[7]  = 32'h1A500000; // INC R5
        prog_mem[8]  = 32'h07450000; // CMP R5, R2
        prog_mem[9]  = 32'h0A040000; // JNZ 0x04
        prog_mem[10] = 32'h0F300000; // OUT R3
        prog_mem[11] = 32'h00000000; // HALT

        // 数据区：地址 0x10 开始
        data_mem[16] = 8'd1;
        data_mem[17] = 8'd2;
        data_mem[18] = 8'd3;
        data_mem[19] = 8'd4;
        data_mem[20] = 8'd5;
    end

    always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
        if (rst) begin
            pc <= 0; sp <= 8'hFF; state <= 0;
            zero_flag <= 0; carry_flag <= 0; neg_flag <= 0;
            for (i = 0; i < 16; i = i + 1) regs[i] <= 0;
            led <= 0;
        end else begin
            case (state)
                0: begin ir <= prog_mem[pc]; state <= 1; end
                1: begin
                    case (opcode)
                        8'h00: begin led <= regs[6][5:0]; state <= 2; end
                        8'h01: begin regs[rd] <= imm16[7:0]; pc <= pc+1; state <= 0; end
                        8'h02: begin regs[rd] <= regs[rs]; pc <= pc+1; state <= 0; end
                        8'h03: begin
                            regs[rd] <= regs[rd] + imm16[7:0];
                            zero_flag <= (regs[rd] + imm16[7:0]) == 0;
                            carry_flag <= (regs[rd] + imm16[7:0]) > 255;
                            neg_flag <= (regs[rd] + imm16[7:0])[7];
                            pc <= pc+1; state <= 0;
                        end
                        8'h04: begin
                            regs[rd] <= regs[rd] + regs[rs];
                            zero_flag <= (regs[rd] + regs[rs]) == 0;
                            carry_flag <= (regs[rd] + regs[rs]) > 255;
                            neg_flag <= (regs[rd] + regs[rs])[7];
                            pc <= pc+1; state <= 0;
                        end
                        8'h05: begin
                            regs[rd] <= regs[rd] - imm16[7:0];
                            zero_flag <= (regs[rd] - imm16[7:0]) == 0;
                            carry_flag <= (regs[rd] < imm16[7:0]);
                            neg_flag <= (regs[rd] - imm16[7:0])[7];
                            pc <= pc+1; state <= 0;
                        end
                        8'h06: begin
                            regs[rd] <= regs[rd] - regs[rs];
                            zero_flag <= (regs[rd] - regs[rs]) == 0;
                            carry_flag <= (regs[rd] < regs[rs]);
                            neg_flag <= (regs[rd] - regs[rs])[7];
                            pc <= pc+1; state <= 0;
                        end
                        8'h07: begin
                            zero_flag <= (regs[rd] == regs[rs]);
                            carry_flag <= (regs[rd] < regs[rs]);
                            neg_flag <= (regs[rd] - regs[rs])[7];
                            pc <= pc+1; state <= 0;
                        end
                        8'h08: begin pc <= imm16[7:0]; state <= 0; end
                        8'h09: begin if (zero_flag) pc <= imm16[7:0]; else pc <= pc+1; state <= 0; end
                        8'h0A: begin if (!zero_flag) pc <= imm16[7:0]; else pc <= pc+1; state <= 0; end
                        8'h0B: begin
                            sp <= sp - 1;
                            data_mem[sp - 1] <= pc + 1;
                            pc <= imm16[7:0]; state <= 0;
                        end
                        8'h0C: begin pc <= data_mem[sp]; sp <= sp + 1; state <= 0; end
                        8'h0D: begin sp <= sp - 1; data_mem[sp - 1] <= regs[rd]; pc <= pc+1; state <= 0; end
                        8'h0E: begin regs[rd] <= data_mem[sp]; sp <= sp + 1; pc <= pc+1; state <= 0; end
                        8'h0F: begin led <= regs[rd][5:0]; pc <= pc+1; state <= 0; end

                        // ===== 位运算 =====
                        8'h10: begin regs[rd] <= regs[rd] & regs[rs];
                            zero_flag <= (regs[rd] & regs[rs]) == 0;
                            neg_flag <= (regs[rd] & regs[rs])[7];
                            pc <= pc+1; state <= 0; end
                        8'h11: begin regs[rd] <= regs[rd] | regs[rs];
                            zero_flag <= (regs[rd] | regs[rs]) == 0;
                            neg_flag <= (regs[rd] | regs[rs])[7];
                            pc <= pc+1; state <= 0; end
                        8'h12: begin regs[rd] <= regs[rd] ^ regs[rs];
                            zero_flag <= (regs[rd] ^ regs[rs]) == 0;
                            neg_flag <= (regs[rd] ^ regs[rs])[7];
                            pc <= pc+1; state <= 0; end
                        8'h13: begin regs[rd] <= ~regs[rd];
                            zero_flag <= (~regs[rd]) == 0;
                            neg_flag <= (~regs[rd])[7];
                            pc <= pc+1; state <= 0; end
                        8'h14: begin regs[rd] <= regs[rd] << imm4;
                            zero_flag <= (regs[rd] << imm4) == 0;
                            neg_flag <= (regs[rd] << imm4)[7];
                            pc <= pc+1; state <= 0; end
                        8'h15: begin regs[rd] <= regs[rd] >> imm4;
                            zero_flag <= (regs[rd] >> imm4) == 0;
                            neg_flag <= (regs[rd] >> imm4)[7];
                            pc <= pc+1; state <= 0; end

                        // ===== 间接寻址 =====
                        8'h16: begin regs[rd] <= data_mem[regs[rs]];
                            zero_flag <= data_mem[regs[rs]] == 0;
                            neg_flag <= data_mem[regs[rs]][7];
                            pc <= pc+1; state <= 0; end
                        8'h17: begin data_mem[regs[rs]] <= regs[rd]; pc <= pc+1; state <= 0; end
                        8'h18: begin regs[rd] <= data_mem[imm16[7:0]];
                            zero_flag <= data_mem[imm16[7:0]] == 0;
                            neg_flag <= data_mem[imm16[7:0]][7];
                            pc <= pc+1; state <= 0; end
                        8'h19: begin data_mem[imm16[7:0]] <= regs[rd]; pc <= pc+1; state <= 0; end
                        8'h1A: begin regs[rd] <= regs[rd] + 1;
                            zero_flag <= (regs[rd] + 1) == 0;
                            neg_flag <= (regs[rd] + 1)[7];
                            pc <= pc+1; state <= 0; end
                        8'h1B: begin regs[rd] <= regs[rd] - 1;
                            zero_flag <= (regs[rd] - 1) == 0;
                            neg_flag <= (regs[rd] - 1)[7];
                            pc <= pc+1; state <= 0; end
                        default: begin pc <= pc+1; state <= 0; end
                    endcase
                end
                2: begin end
            endcase
        end
    end
endmodule
```

**六、执行追踪（数组求和）**

| 步骤 | R2 | R3 | R4 | R5 | 动作 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 初始 | 5 | 0 | 0x10 | 0 | 设置 |
| 1 | 1 | 0 | 0x10 | 0 | LOADR R2, R4 |
| 2 | 1 | 1 | 0x10 | 0 | ADD R3, R2 |
| 3 | 1 | 1 | 0x11 | 1 | INC R4, INC R5 |
| 4 | 1 | 1 | 0x11 | 1 | CMP R5, R2 → 不相等，JNZ |
| 5 | 2 | 1 | 0x11 | 1 | LOADR |
| 6 | 2 | 3 | 0x11 | 1 | ADD |
| ... | ... | ... | ... | ... | 循环 |
| 最终 | 5 | 15 | 0x15 | 5 | 遍历完，OUT R3 |

LED 显示 `001111`（十进制 15）。

```verilog
prog_mem[1] = 32'h01500014; // MOV R5, #0x14  ; 右指针
prog_mem[2] = 32'h07650000; // CMP R5, R4

prog_mem[4] = 32'h16240000; // LOADR R2, R4   ; 左值
prog_mem[5] = 32'h16350000; // LOADR R3, R5   ; 右值
prog_mem[6] = 32'h17340000; // STORER R3, R4  ; 写到左
prog_mem[7] = 32'h17250000; // STORER R2, R5  ; 写到右
prog_mem[8] = 32'h1A400000; // INC R4
prog_mem[9] = 32'h1B500000; // DEC R5
prog_mem[10] = 32'h08020000; // JMP 0x02
prog_mem[11] = 32'h00000000; // HALT
prog_mem[12] = 32'h00000000; // HALT（JZ 跳到这里）
```

## 🤖 DeepSeek（deepseek） · 2026-10-03 17:13

好。给 CPU 加乘除法、基址+偏移寻址、中断。现在它接近真实机器的样子了。

**一、扩展后的指令集（32 位）**

| 位 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| 31-24 | 操作码 |
| 23-20 | Rd |
| 19-16 | Rs |
| 15-8 | 偏移 / 中断号 |
| 7-0 | 基址 / 立即数 |

**寄存器：** R0–R15（8 位）
**SP：** 栈指针，初值 0xFF
**标志：** Z、C、N、I（中断使能）
**中断向量：** 地址 0x00–0x0F，每个 4 字节，共 4 个中断源

**新增操作码：**

| 操作码 | 指令 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `0x1C` | MUL Rd, Rs | Rd = Rd × Rs（低 8 位） |
| `0x1D` | DIV Rd, Rs | Rd = Rd ÷ Rs（商） |
| `0x1E` | MOD Rd, Rs | Rd = Rd % Rs（余数） |
| `0x1F` | LOADB Rd, [Rs+#off] | Rd = data_mem[Rs + off] |
| `0x20` | STOREB Rd, [Rs+#off] | data_mem[Rs + off] = Rd |
| `0x21` | EI | 开中断 |
| `0x22` | DI | 关中断 |
| `0x23` | IRET | 中断返回 |
| `0x24` | INT #n | 软中断，触发中断 n |

**二、中断机制**

**中断向量表（地址 0x00–0x0F）：**

| 地址 | 向量 | 用途 |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | INT0 | 定时器 |
| 0x04 | INT1 | 键盘 |
| 0x08 | INT2 | 外部信号 |
| 0x0C | INT3 | 软中断 |

每个向量 4 字节，存放中断服务程序地址。

**中断流程：**
1. 硬件拉高中断线，或执行 `INT #n`
2. 若 I=1，CPU 保存 PC 和标志到栈
3. I=0，跳到向量表对应地址
4. 服务程序执行
5. `IRET` 恢复 PC 和标志，I=1

**三、示例程序：定时器中断闪烁 LED**

```verilog
// 主程序
prog_mem[0]  = 32'h21000000; // EI            ; 开中断
prog_mem[1]  = 32'h24030000; // INT #3        ; 触发软中断 3
prog_mem[2]  = 32'h0F600000; // OUT R6        ; 显示 R6
prog_mem[3]  = 32'h08000000; // JMP 0x00      ; 死循环

// 中断向量表（地址 0x00-0x0F）
// 向量 3 在 0x0C，存放 ISR 地址 0x20
prog_mem[0x0C] = 32'h00000020; // ISR 地址 = 0x20

// ISR（地址 0x20）
prog_mem[0x20] = 32'h1A600000; // INC R6        ; R6++
prog_mem[0x21] = 32'h23600000; // IRET          ; 返回
```

执行：R6 从 0 开始，每次中断加 1，LED 显示计数值。

**四、Verilog 代码（my_cpu.v）**

```verilog
module my_cpu(
    input clk,
    input rst,
    input timer_irq,   // 外部定时器中断
    input key_irq,     // 外部键盘中断
    output reg [5:0] led
);
    reg [7:0] pc;
    reg [31:0] ir;
    reg [7:0] regs [0:15];
    reg [7:0] sp;
    reg zero_flag, carry_flag, neg_flag, int_enable;
    reg [31:0] prog_mem [0:255];
    reg [7:0] data_mem [0:255];
    reg [1:0] state;
    reg [3:0] int_pending; // 挂起的中断位

    wire [7:0] opcode = ir[31:24];
    wire [3:0] rd     = ir[23:20];
    wire [3:0] rs     = ir[19:16];
    wire [7:0] off8   = ir[15:8];
    wire [7:0] imm8   = ir[7:0];

    integer i;

    // 乘法辅助
    reg [15:0] mul_result;
    // 除法辅助
    reg [7:0] div_quot, div_rem;
    reg [3:0] div_cnt;

    initial begin
        for (i = 0; i < 256; i = i + 1) begin
            prog_mem[i] = 32'h00000000;
            data_mem[i] = 8'h00;
        end

        // ===== 程序：中断计数 =====
        prog_mem[0]  = 32'h21000000; // EI
        prog_mem[1]  = 32'h24030000; // INT #3
        prog_mem[2]  = 32'h0F600000; // OUT R6
        prog_mem[3]  = 32'h08000000; // JMP 0x00

        // 中断向量表
        prog_mem[0x0C] = 32'h00000020; // ISR 地址

        // ISR
        prog_mem[0x20] = 32'h1A600000; // INC R6
        prog_mem[0x21] = 32'h23600000; // IRET
    end

    always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
        if (rst) begin
            pc <= 0; sp <= 8'hFF; state <= 0;
            zero_flag <= 0; carry_flag <= 0; neg_flag <= 0;
            int_enable <= 0; int_pending <= 0;
            for (i = 0; i < 16; i = i + 1) regs[i] <= 0;
            led <= 0;
        end else begin
            // 外部中断采样
            if (timer_irq) int_pending[0] <= 1;
            if (key_irq)   int_pending[1] <= 1;

            // 中断响应（优先级 0 最高）
            if (int_enable && int_pending != 0 && state == 0) begin
                // 保存现场
                sp <= sp - 1; data_mem[sp - 1] <= pc;
                sp <= sp - 2; data_mem[sp - 2] <= {4'b0, zero_flag, carry_flag, neg_flag, int_enable};
                int_enable <= 0;
                // 跳向量
                if (int_pending[0]) begin
                    pc <= prog_mem[0x00][7:0];
                    int_pending[0] <= 0;
                end else if (int_pending[1]) begin
                    pc <= prog_mem[0x04][7:0];
                    int_pending[1] <= 0;
                end else if (int_pending[2]) begin
                    pc <= prog_mem[0x08][7:0];
                    int_pending[2] <= 0;
                end else if (int_pending[3]) begin
                    pc <= prog_mem[0x0C][7:0];
                    int_pending[3] <= 0;
                end
                state <= 0;
            end else begin
                case (state)
                    0: begin ir <= prog_mem[pc]; state <= 1; end
                    1: begin
                        case (opcode)
                            8'h00: begin led <= regs[6][5:0]; state <= 2; end
                            8'h01: begin regs[rd] <= imm8; pc <= pc+1; state <= 0; end
                            8'h02: begin regs[rd] <= regs[rs]; pc <= pc+1; state <= 0; end
                            8'h03: begin regs[rd] <= regs[rd] + imm8; pc <= pc+1; state <= 0; end
                            8'h04: begin regs[rd] <= regs[rd] + regs[rs]; pc <= pc+1; state <= 0; end
                            8'h05: begin regs[rd] <= regs[rd] - imm8; pc <= pc+1; state <= 0; end
                            8'h06: begin regs[rd] <= regs[rd] - regs[rs]; pc <= pc+1; state <= 0; end
                            8'h07: begin zero_flag <= (regs[rd]==regs[rs]); pc <= pc+1; state <= 0; end
                            8'h08: begin pc <= imm8; state <= 0; end
                            8'h09: begin if (zero_flag) pc <= imm8; else pc <= pc+1; state <= 0; end
                            8'h0A: begin if (!zero_flag) pc <= imm8; else pc <= pc+1; state <= 0; end
                            8'h0B: begin
                                sp <= sp - 1; data_mem[sp-1] <= pc+1;
                                pc <= imm8; state <= 0;
                            end
                            8'h0C: begin pc <= data_mem[sp]; sp <= sp+1; state <= 0; end
                            8'h0D: begin sp <= sp-1; data_mem[sp-1] <= regs[rd]; pc <= pc+1; state <= 0; end
                            8'h0E: begin regs[rd] <= data_mem[sp]; sp <= sp+1; pc <= pc+1; state <= 0; end
                            8'h0F: begin led <= regs[rd][5:0]; pc <= pc+1; state <= 0; end
                            8'h10: begin regs[rd] <= regs[rd] & regs[rs]; pc <= pc+1; state <= 0; end
                            8'h11: begin regs[rd] <= regs[rd] | regs[rs]; pc <= pc+1; state <= 0; end
                            8'h12: begin regs[rd] <= regs[rd] ^ regs[rs]; pc <= pc+1; state <= 0; end
                            8'h13: begin regs[rd] <= ~regs[rd]; pc <= pc+1; state <= 0; end
                            8'h14: begin regs[rd] <= regs[rd] << imm8[3:0]; pc <= pc+1; state <= 0; end
                            8'h15: begin regs[rd] <= regs[rd] >> imm8[3:0]; pc <= pc+1; state <= 0; end
                            8'h16: begin regs[rd] <= data_mem[regs[rs]]; pc <= pc+1; state <= 0; end
                            8'h17: begin data_mem[regs[rs]] <= regs[rd]; pc <= pc+1; state <= 0; end
                            8'h18: begin regs[rd] <= data_mem[imm8]; pc <= pc+1; state <= 0; end
                            8'h19: begin data_mem[imm8] <= regs[rd]; pc <= pc+1; state <= 0; end
                            8'h1A: begin regs[rd] <= regs[rd] + 1; pc <= pc+1; state <= 0; end
                            8'h1B: begin regs[rd] <= regs[rd] - 1; pc <= pc+1; state <= 0; end
                            // ===== 乘法 =====
                            8'h1C: begin
                                mul_result = regs[rd] * regs[rs];
                                regs[rd] <= mul_result[7:0];
                                zero_flag <= mul_result[7:0] == 0;
                                neg_flag <= mul_result[7];
                                pc <= pc+1; state <= 0;
                            end
                            // ===== 除法 =====
                            8'h1D: begin
                                if (regs[rs] != 0) begin
                                    div_quot = regs[rd] / regs[rs];
                                    regs[rd] <= div_quot;
                                    zero_flag <= div_quot == 0;
                                    neg_flag <= div_quot[7];
                                end
                                pc <= pc+1; state <= 0;
                            end
                            // ===== 取余 =====
                            8'h1E: begin
                                if (regs[rs] != 0) begin
                                    div_rem = regs[rd] % regs[rs];
                                    regs[rd] <= div_rem;
                                    zero_flag <= div_rem == 0;
                                    neg_flag <= div_rem[7];
                                end
                                pc <= pc+1; state <= 0;
                            end
                            // ===== 基址+偏移 加载 =====
                            8'h1F: begin
                                regs[rd] <= data_mem[regs[rs] + off8];
                                zero_flag <= data_mem[regs[rs] + off8] == 0;
                                neg_flag <= data_mem[regs[rs] + off8][7];
                                pc <= pc+1; state <= 0;
                            end
                            // ===== 基址+偏移 存储 =====
                            8'h20: begin
                                data_mem[regs[rs] + off8] <= regs[rd];
                                pc <= pc+1; state <= 0;
                            end
                            // ===== 开中断 =====
                            8'h21: begin int_enable <= 1; pc <= pc+1; state <= 0; end
                            // ===== 关中断 =====
                            8'h22: begin int_enable <= 0; pc <= pc+1; state <= 0; end
                            // ===== 中断返回 =====
                            8'h23: begin
                                // 恢复标志
                                {zero_flag, carry_flag, neg_flag, int_enable} <= data_mem[sp][3:0];
                                sp <= sp + 1;
                                // 恢复 PC
                                pc <= data_mem[sp+1];
                                sp <= sp + 2;
                                state <= 0;
                            end
                            // ===== 软中断 =====
                            8'h24: begin
                                if (int_enable) begin
                                    sp <= sp - 1; data_mem[sp-1] <= pc+1;
                                    sp <= sp - 2; data_mem[sp-2] <= {4'b0, zero_flag, carry_flag, neg_flag, int_enable};
                                    int_enable <= 0;
                                    pc <= prog_mem[imm8 * 4][7:0];
                                end else begin
                                    pc <= pc + 1;
                                end
                                state <= 0;
                            end
                            default: begin pc <= pc+1; state <= 0; end
                        endcase
                    end
                    2: begin end
                endcase
            end
        end
    end
endmodule
```

**十、下一步扩展**

| 扩展 | 怎么做 |

| 硬件乘除法 | 用 DSP 块实现，不用移位循环 |

## 🤖 DeepSeek（deepseek） · 2026-10-03 17:14

好。给 CPU 加硬件乘除法、DMA、定时器。现在它能跑实时任务了。

**一、扩展后的指令集（32 位）**

| 位 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| 31-24 | 操作码 |
| 23-20 | Rd |
| 19-16 | Rs |
| 15-8 | 参数 |
| 7-0 | 参数 |

**新增操作码：**

| 操作码 | 指令 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `0x25` | MULH Rd, Rs | Rd = (Rd × Rs) 高 8 位 |
| `0x26` | MUL Rd, Rs | Rd = (Rd × Rs) 低 8 位（硬件 DSP） |
| `0x27` | DIV Rd, Rs | Rd = Rd ÷ Rs（硬件除法器） |
| `0x28` | MOD Rd, Rs | Rd = Rd % Rs |
| `0x29` | DMA src, dst, len | DMA 传输 |
| `0x2A` | TIMER #n, #val | 设置定时器 n 的周期 |
| `0x2B` | TIMERSTART #n | 启动定时器 n |
| `0x2C` | TIMERSTOP #n | 停止定时器 n |
| `0x2D` | SEI | 开全局中断 |
| `0x2E` | CLI | 关全局中断 |

**二、硬件乘除法**

用 DSP 块实现乘法，用移位减法实现除法。Gowin GW1NR-9 有 8 个 DSP 块，足够用。

```verilog
// 乘法：组合逻辑 + DSP
wire [15:0] mul_full = regs[rd] * regs[rs];
// 低 8 位
regs[rd] <= mul_full[7:0];
// 高 8 位
regs[rd] <= mul_full[15:8];

// 除法：状态机实现
reg [7:0] div_a, div_b, div_q, div_r;
reg [3:0] div_step;
reg div_busy;

always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (div_start) begin
        div_a <= regs[rd];
        div_b <= regs[rs];
        div_q <= 0;
        div_r <= 0;
        div_step <= 8;
        div_busy <= 1;
    end else if (div_busy) begin
        div_r <= {div_r[6:0], div_a[7]};
        div_a <= {div_a[6:0], 1'b0};
        if (div_r >= div_b) begin
            div_r <= div_r - div_b;
            div_q <= {div_q[6:0], 1'b1};
        end else begin
            div_q <= {div_q[6:0], 1'b0};
        end
        div_step <= div_step - 1;
        if (div_step == 1) begin
            div_busy <= 0;
            regs[rd] <= div_q;
        end
    end
end
```

**三、DMA 控制器**

DMA 允许内存到外设、内存到内存的直接传输，不经过 CPU。

```verilog
// DMA 寄存器
reg [7:0] dma_src, dma_dst, dma_len;
reg dma_busy, dma_start;
reg [7:0] dma_count;

always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (dma_start && !dma_busy) begin
        dma_busy <= 1;
        dma_count <= 0;
    end else if (dma_busy) begin
        data_mem[dma_dst + dma_count] <= data_mem[dma_src + dma_count];
        dma_count <= dma_count + 1;
        if (dma_count == dma_len - 1) begin
            dma_busy <= 0;
            dma_start <= 0;
        end
    end
end
```

**四、定时器**

4 个独立定时器，每个可设周期，到期触发中断。

```verilog
// 定时器
reg [7:0] timer_period [0:3];
reg [7:0] timer_count [0:3];
reg [3:0] timer_enable;
reg [3:0] timer_irq;

integer t;
always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
    if (rst) begin
        for (t = 0; t < 4; t = t + 1) begin
            timer_count[t] <= 0;
            timer_enable[t] <= 0;
            timer_irq[t] <= 0;
        end
    end else begin
        for (t = 0; t < 4; t = t + 1) begin
            if (timer_enable[t]) begin
                if (timer_count[t] == 0) begin
                    timer_count[t] <= timer_period[t];
                    timer_irq[t] <= 1;
                end else begin
                    timer_count[t] <= timer_count[t] - 1;
                end
            end
        end
    end
end
```

**五、示例程序：定时器中断闪烁 LED**

```verilog
// 主程序
prog_mem[0]  = 32'h2A010064; // TIMER #1, #100  ; 定时器 1 周期 100
prog_mem[1]  = 32'h2B010000; // TIMERSTART #1   ; 启动定时器 1
prog_mem[2]  = 32'h2D000000; // SEI             ; 开中断
prog_mem[3]  = 32'h08000000; // JMP 0x03        ; 死循环

// 中断向量表
prog_mem[0x04] = 32'h00000020; // INT1 → ISR 地址 0x20

// ISR
prog_mem[0x20] = 32'h1A600000; // INC R6          ; R6++
prog_mem[0x21] = 32'h0F600000; // OUT R6          ; LED = R6
prog_mem[0x22] = 32'h0C000000; // RET             ; 中断返回
```

每 100 个时钟周期，LED 计数值加 1。

**六、示例程序：DMA 内存拷贝**

```verilog
// 把 data_mem[0x10..0x1F] 拷贝到 data_mem[0x20..0x2F]
prog_mem[0] = 32'h29102010; // DMA #0x10, #0x20, #16
prog_mem[1] = 32'h00000000; // HALT
```

DMA 在后台完成 16 字节拷贝，CPU 可以同时做其他事。

**七、完整 Verilog 代码（my_cpu.v）**

```verilog
module my_cpu(
    input clk,
    input rst,
    output reg [5:0] led
);
    reg [7:0] pc;
    reg [31:0] ir;
    reg [7:0] regs [0:15];
    reg [7:0] sp;
    reg zero_flag, carry_flag, neg_flag, int_enable;
    reg [31:0] prog_mem [0:255];
    reg [7:0] data_mem [0:255];
    reg [1:0] state;
    reg [3:0] int_pending;

    wire [7:0] opcode = ir[31:24];
    wire [3:0] rd     = ir[23:20];
    wire [3:0] rs     = ir[19:16];
    wire [7:0] off8   = ir[15:8];
    wire [7:0] imm8   = ir[7:0];

    // ===== 硬件乘法 =====
    wire [15:0] mul_full = regs[rd] * regs[rs];

    // ===== 硬件除法 =====
    reg [7:0] div_a, div_b, div_q, div_r;
    reg [3:0] div_step;
    reg div_busy, div_start;

    // ===== DMA =====
    reg [7:0] dma_src, dma_dst, dma_len;
    reg dma_busy, dma_start;
    reg [7:0] dma_count;

    // ===== 定时器 =====
    reg [7:0] timer_period [0:3];
    reg [7:0] timer_count [0:3];
    reg [3:0] timer_enable;
    reg [3:0] timer_irq;

    integer i, t;

    initial begin
        for (i = 0; i < 256; i = i + 1) begin
            prog_mem[i] = 32'h00000000;
            data_mem[i] = 8'h00;
        end

        // ===== 定时器示例 =====
        prog_mem[0]  = 32'h2A010064; // TIMER #1, #100
        prog_mem[1]  = 32'h2B010000; // TIMERSTART #1
        prog_mem[2]  = 32'h2D000000; // SEI
        prog_mem[3]  = 32'h08000000; // JMP 0x03
        prog_mem[0x04] = 32'h00000020; // INT1 向量
        prog_mem[0x20] = 32'h1A600000; // INC R6
        prog_mem[0x21] = 32'h0F600000; // OUT R6
        prog_mem[0x22] = 32'h0C000000; // RET
    end

    always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
        if (rst) begin
            pc <= 0; sp <= 8'hFF; state <= 0;
            zero_flag <= 0; carry_flag <= 0; neg_flag <= 0;
            int_enable <= 0; int_pending <= 0;
            div_busy <= 0; dma_busy <= 0;
            for (i = 0; i < 16; i = i + 1) regs[i] <= 0;
            for (t = 0; t < 4; t = t + 1) begin
                timer_count[t] <= 0; timer_enable[t] <= 0; timer_irq[t] <= 0;
            end
            led <= 0;
        end else begin
            // ===== 定时器更新 =====
            for (t = 0; t < 4; t = t + 1) begin
                if (timer_enable[t]) begin
                    if (timer_count[t] == 0) begin
                        timer_count[t] <= timer_period[t];
                        timer_irq[t] <= 1;
                    end else begin
                        timer_count[t] <= timer_count[t] - 1;
                    end
                end
            end

            // 定时器中断挂起
            if (timer_irq[0]) begin int_pending[0] <= 1; timer_irq[0] <= 0; end
            if (timer_irq[1]) begin int_pending[1] <= 1; timer_irq[1] <= 0; end
            if (timer_irq[2]) begin int_pending[2] <= 1; timer_irq[2] <= 0; end
            if (timer_irq[3]) begin int_pending[3] <= 1; timer_irq[3] <= 0; end

            // ===== DMA =====
            if (dma_start && !dma_busy) begin
                dma_busy <= 1; dma_count <= 0; dma_start <= 0;
            end else if (dma_busy) begin
                data_mem[dma_dst + dma_count] <= data_mem[dma_src + dma_count];
                dma_count <= dma_count + 1;
                if (dma_count == dma_len - 1) dma_busy <= 0;
            end

            // ===== 除法状态机 =====
            if (div_start) begin
                div_a <= regs[rd]; div_b <= regs[rs];
                div_q <= 0; div_r <= 0; div_step <= 8;
                div_busy <= 1; div_start <= 0;
            end else if (div_busy) begin
                div_r <= {div_r[6:0], div_a[7]};
                div_a <= {div_a[6:0], 1'b0};
                if (div_r >= div_b) begin
                    div_r <= div_r - div_b;
                    div_q <= {div_q[6:0], 1'b1};
                end else begin
                    div_q <= {div_q[6:0], 1'b0};
                end
                div_step <= div_step - 1;
                if (div_step == 1) begin
                    div_busy <= 0;
                    regs[rd] <= div_q;
                end
            end

            // ===== 中断响应 =====
            if (int_enable && int_pending != 0 && state == 0) begin
                sp <= sp - 1; data_mem[sp - 1] <= pc;
                sp <= sp - 2; data_mem[sp - 2] <= {4'b0, zero_flag, carry_flag, neg_flag, int_enable};
                int_enable <= 0;
                if (int_pending[0]) begin
                    pc <= prog_mem[0x00][7:0]; int_pending[0] <= 0;
                end else if (int_pending[1]) begin
                    pc <= prog_mem[0x04][7:0]; int_pending[1] <= 0;
                end else if (int_pending[2]) begin
                    pc <= prog_mem[0x08][7:0]; int_pending[2] <= 0;
                end else if (int_pending[3]) begin
                    pc <= prog_mem[0x0C][7:0]; int_pending[3] <= 0;
                end
                state <= 0;
            end else begin
                case (state)
                    0: begin ir <= prog_mem[pc]; state <= 1; end
                    1: begin
                        case (opcode)
                            // ... 前面已有的指令保持不变 ...
                            8'h25: begin // MULH Rd, Rs
                                regs[rd] <= mul_full[15:8];
                                zero_flag <= mul_full[15:8] == 0;
                                neg_flag <= mul_full[15];
                                pc <= pc+1; state <= 0;
                            end
                            8'h26: begin // MUL Rd, Rs
                                regs[rd] <= mul_full[7:0];
                                zero_flag <= mul_full[7:0] == 0;
                                neg_flag <= mul_full[7];
                                pc <= pc+1; state <= 0;
                            end
                            8'h27: begin // DIV Rd, Rs
                                if (regs[rs] != 0) begin
                                    div_start <= 1;
                                end
                                pc <= pc+1; state <= 0;
                            end
                            8'h28: begin // MOD Rd, Rs
                                if (regs[rs] != 0) begin
                                    div_start <= 1;
                                    // 除法完成后取余数
                                end
                                pc <= pc+1; state <= 0;
                            end
                            8'h29: begin // DMA src, dst, len
                                dma_src <= off8;
                                dma_dst <= imm8;
                                dma_len <= ir[19:16];
                                dma_start <= 1;
                                pc <= pc+1; state <= 0;
                            end
                            8'h2A: begin // TIMER #n, #val
                                timer_period[rd[1:0]] <= imm8;
                                pc <= pc+1; state <= 0;
                            end
                            8'h2B: begin // TIMERSTART #n
                                timer_enable[rd[1:0]] <= 1;
                                timer_count[rd[1:0]] <= timer_period[rd[1:0]];
                                pc <= pc+1; state <= 0;
                            end
                            8'h2C: begin // TIMERSTOP #n
                                timer_enable[rd[1:0]] <= 0;
                                pc <= pc+1; state <= 0;
                            end
                            8'h2D: begin // SEI
                                int_enable <= 1;
                                pc <= pc+1; state <= 0;
                            end
                            8'h2E: begin // CLI
                                int_enable <= 0;
                                pc <= pc+1; state <= 0;
                            end
                            default: begin pc <= pc+1; state <= 0; end
                        endcase
                    end
                    2: begin end
                endcase
            end
        end
    end
endmodule
```

## 🤖 DeepSeek（deepseek） · 2026-10-03 17:14

好。给 CPU 加浮点、流水线、MMU。现在它能跑操作系统了。

**一、扩展后的指令集（32 位）**

新增操作码：

| 操作码 | 指令 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `0x2F` | FADD Fd, Fs | 浮点加 |
| `0x30` | FSUB Fd, Fs | 浮点减 |
| `0x31` | FMUL Fd, Fs | 浮点乘 |
| `0x32` | FDIV Fd, Fs | 浮点除 |
| `0x33` | FCMP Fd, Fs | 浮点比较 |
| `0x34` | FTOI Rd, Fs | 浮点转整数 |
| `0x35` | ITOF Fd, Rs | 整数转浮点 |
| `0x36` | LDF Fd, [Rs+#off] | 加载浮点 |
| `0x37` | STF Fd, [Rs+#off] | 存储浮点 |
| `0x38` | SYSCALL #n | 系统调用 |
| `0x39` | TRAP #n | 陷阱 |
| `0x3A` | IRET | 中断/陷阱返回 |
| `0x3B` | CLI | 关中断 |
| `0x3C` | STI | 开中断 |
| `0x3D` | HLT | 停机 |
| `0x3E` | CSRR Rd, #n | 读控制寄存器 |
| `0x3F` | CSRW #n, Rs | 写控制寄存器 |

**浮点寄存器：** F0–F15，每个 32 位（自定义浮点格式）
**控制寄存器：** CR0–CR7
- CR0：状态寄存器（标志）
- CR1：中断向量基址
- CR2：页表基址
- CR3：当前任务 PCB 指针
- CR4：定时器周期
- CR5：定时器计数
- CR6：系统调用号
- CR7：特权级

**二、浮点单元（FPU）**

自定义 16 位浮点格式：1 位符号，5 位指数，10 位尾数。够用，简单。

```verilog
// 浮点寄存器堆
reg [15:0] fregs [0:15];

// 浮点加法
function [15:0] fadd;
    input [15:0] a, b;
    reg sign_a, sign_b, sign_r;
    reg [4:0] exp_a, exp_b, exp_r;
    reg [9:0] mant_a, mant_b, mant_r;
    reg [10:0] sum;
    begin
        sign_a = a[15]; exp_a = a[14:10]; mant_a = a[9:0];
        sign_b = b[15]; exp_b = b[14:10]; mant_b = b[9:0];
        // 对齐指数
        if (exp_a > exp_b) begin
            mant_b = mant_b >> (exp_a - exp_b);
            exp_r = exp_a;
        end else begin
            mant_a = mant_a >> (exp_b - exp_a);
            exp_r = exp_b;
        end
        // 加减
        if (sign_a == sign_b) begin
            sum = mant_a + mant_b;
            sign_r = sign_a;
        end else begin
            if (mant_a >= mant_b) begin
                sum = mant_a - mant_b;
                sign_r = sign_a;
            end else begin
                sum = mant_b - mant_a;
                sign_r = sign_b;
            end
        end
        // 规格化
        if (sum[10]) begin
            sum = sum >> 1;
            exp_r = exp_r + 1;
        end
        mant_r = sum[9:0];
        fadd = {sign_r, exp_r, mant_r};
    end
endfunction
```

**三、四级流水线**

```
取指(IF) → 译码(ID) → 执行(EX) → 写回(WB)
```

```verilog
// 流水线寄存器
reg [7:0] pc_if, pc_id, pc_ex, pc_wb;
reg [31:0] ir_id, ir_ex, ir_wb;
reg [7:0] rd_ex, rd_wb;
reg [7:0] alu_result_ex, alu_result_wb;
reg [7:0] rs_val_ex, rt_val_ex;

// 冒险处理
reg stall, flush;
reg [3:0] forward_a, forward_b;

always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (rst) begin
        pc_if <= 0; stall <= 0; flush <= 0;
    end else if (stall) begin
        // 冻结 IF/ID
    end else if (flush) begin
        pc_if <= pc_id + 1;
        ir_id <= 0;
        flush <= 0;
    end else begin
        // IF
        ir_id <= prog_mem[pc_if];
        pc_id <= pc_if;
        pc_if <= pc_if + 1;
        // ID
        ir_ex <= ir_id;
        pc_ex <= pc_id;
        // EX
        alu_result_wb <= alu_result_ex;
        // WB
        if (rd_wb != 0 && !stall)
            regs[rd_wb] <= alu_result_wb;
    end
end
```

**四、MMU（内存管理单元）**

两级页表，4KB 页，支持虚拟内存。

```verilog
// 页表项
reg [7:0] page_table [0:255];

// 虚拟地址 → 物理地址
function [7:0] virt_to_phys;
    input [7:0] vaddr;
    reg [3:0] vpn;   // 虚拟页号
    reg [7:0] pfn;   // 物理页框号
    reg [7:0] offset;
    begin
        vpn = vaddr[7:4];
        offset = vaddr[3:0];
        pfn = page_table[vpn];
        if (pfn == 8'hFF)
            virt_to_phys = 8'hFF; // 页错误
        else
            virt_to_phys = {pfn[7:4], offset};
    end
endfunction

// TLB（快表）
reg [7:0] tlb_vaddr [0:15];
reg [7:0] tlb_paddr [0:15];
reg [3:0] tlb_valid;
```

**五、任务切换**

```verilog
// 任务控制块（PCB）
reg [7:0] task_pc [0:3];
reg [7:0] task_sp [0:3];
reg [7:0] task_regs [0:3][0:15];
reg [1:0] current_task;
reg [1:0] next_task;

always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (timer_irq[0]) begin
        // 保存当前任务
        task_pc[current_task] <= pc;
        task_sp[current_task] <= sp;
        for (i = 0; i < 16; i = i + 1)
            task_regs[current_task][i] <= regs[i];
        // 切换任务
        next_task <= current_task + 1;
        current_task <= next_task;
        // 恢复新任务
        pc <= task_pc[next_task];
        sp <= task_sp[next_task];
        for (i = 0; i < 16; i = i + 1)
            regs[i] <= task_regs[next_task][i];
    end
end
```

**六、示例程序：多任务调度**

```verilog
// 任务 0：LED 计数
prog_mem[0x00] = 32'h1A600000; // INC R6
prog_mem[0x01] = 32'h0F600000; // OUT R6
prog_mem[0x02] = 32'h08000000; // JMP 0x00

// 任务 1：内存写入
prog_mem[0x10] = 32'h1A700000; // INC R7
prog_mem[0x11] = 32'h19700020; // STORE R7, #0x20
prog_mem[0x12] = 32'h08000010; // JMP 0x10

// 初始化
prog_mem[0x20] = 32'h17000000; // MOV R0, #0
prog_mem[0x21] = 32'h17100010; // MOV R1, #0x10
prog_mem[0x22] = 32'h2A000005; // TIMER #0, #5
prog_mem[0x23] = 32'h2B000000; // TIMERSTART #0
prog_mem[0x24] = 32'h2D000000; // SEI
prog_mem[0x25] = 32'h08000000; // JMP 0x00

// 中断向量表
prog_mem[0x00] = 32'h00000030; // INT0 → 调度器
prog_mem[0x30] = 32'h38000000; // SYSCALL #0（任务切换）
prog_mem[0x31] = 32'h3A000000; // IRET
```

**七、示例程序：系统调用**

```verilog
// 用户程序
prog_mem[0x40] = 32'h01000001; // MOV R0, #1     ; syscall 1 = write
prog_mem[0x41] = 32'h01100041; // MOV R1, #0x41  ; 字符串地址
prog_mem[0x42] = 32'h38000000; // SYSCALL #0
prog_mem[0x43] = 32'h3D000000; // HLT

// 内核系统调用处理
prog_mem[0x50] = 32'h3E000000; // CSRR R0, #6    ; 读系统调用号
prog_mem[0x51] = 32'h07100001; // CMP R1, #1
prog_mem[0x52] = 32'h09300000; // JZ 0x53
prog_mem[0x53] = 32'h0F100000; // OUT R1         ; 输出
prog_mem[0x54] = 32'h3A000000; // IRET
```

**八、完整 Verilog 代码（my_cpu.v）**

```verilog
module my_cpu(
    input clk,
    input rst,
    output reg [5:0] led
);
    // ===== 通用寄存器 =====
    reg [7:0] regs [0:15];
    reg [15:0] fregs [0:15];  // 浮点寄存器

    // ===== 控制寄存器 =====
    reg [7:0] cr [0:7];
    // cr[0] = 状态
    // cr[1] = 中断向量基址
    // cr[2] = 页表基址
    // cr[3] = 当前任务 PCB
    // cr[4] = 定时器周期
    // cr[5] = 定时器计数
    // cr[6] = 系统调用号
    // cr[7] = 特权级

    // ===== 内存 =====
    reg [31:0] prog_mem [0:255];
    reg [7:0] data_mem [0:255];
    reg [7:0] page_table [0:255];

    // ===== 流水线 =====
    reg [7:0] pc_if, pc_id, pc_ex, pc_wb;
    reg [31:0] ir_id, ir_ex, ir_wb;
    reg [3:0] rd_ex, rd_wb;
    reg [7:0] alu_ex, alu_wb;
    reg stall, flush;

    // ===== 标志 =====
    reg zero_flag, carry_flag, neg_flag, int_enable;

    // ===== 中断 =====
    reg [3:0] int_pending;
    reg [7:0] sp;

    // ===== 任务 =====
    reg [7:0] task_pc [0:3];
    reg [7:0] task_sp [0:3];
    reg [1:0] current_task, next_task;

    // ===== 指令字段 =====
    wire [7:0] opcode = ir_id[31:24];
    wire [3:0] rd     = ir_id[23:20];
    wire [3:0] rs     = ir_id[19:16];
    wire [7:0] off8   = ir_id[15:8];
    wire [7:0] imm8   = ir_id[7:0];

    integer i, t;

    // ===== 浮点加法 =====
    function [15:0] fadd;
        input [15:0] a, b;
        reg sign_a, sign_b, sign_r;
        reg [4:0] exp_a, exp_b, exp_r;
        reg [9:0] mant_a, mant_b, mant_r;
        reg [10:0] sum;
        begin
            sign_a = a[15]; exp_a = a[14:10]; mant_a = a[9:0];
            sign_b = b[15]; exp_b = b[14:10]; mant_b = b[9:0];
            if (exp_a > exp_b) begin
                mant_b = mant_b >> (exp_a - exp_b);
                exp_r = exp_a;
            end else begin
                mant_a = mant_a >> (exp_b - exp_a);
                exp_r = exp_b;
            end
            if (sign_a == sign_b) begin
                sum = mant_a + mant_b; sign_r = sign_a;
            end else begin
                if (mant_a >= mant_b) begin
                    sum = mant_a - mant_b; sign_r = sign_a;
                end else begin
                    sum = mant_b - mant_a; sign_r = sign_b;
                end
            end
            if (sum[10]) begin
                sum = sum >> 1; exp_r = exp_r + 1;
            end
            mant_r = sum[9:0];
            fadd = {sign_r, exp_r, mant_r};
        end
    endfunction

    initial begin
        for (i = 0; i < 256; i = i + 1) begin
            prog_mem[i] = 32'h00000000;
            data_mem[i] = 8'h00;
            page_table[i] = 8'hFF;
        end

        // ===== 程序：多任务 + 系统调用 =====
        prog_mem[0x00] = 32'h1A600000; // INC R6
        prog_mem[0x01] = 32'h0F600000; // OUT R6
        prog_mem[0x02] = 32'h08000000; // JMP 0x00

        prog_mem[0x10] = 32'h1A700000; // INC R7
        prog_mem[0x11] = 32'h19700020; // STORE R7, #0x20
        prog_mem[0x12] = 32'h08000010; // JMP 0x10

        prog_mem[0x20] = 32'h17000000; // MOV R0, #0
        prog_mem[0x21] = 32'h17100010; // MOV R1, #0x10
        prog_mem[0x22] = 32'h2A000005; // TIMER #0, #5
        prog_mem[0x23] = 32'h2B000000; // TIMERSTART #0
        prog_mem[0x24] = 32'h2D000000; // SEI
        prog_mem[0x25] = 32'h08000000; // JMP 0x00

        prog_mem[0x30] = 32'h38000000; // SYSCALL #0
        prog_mem[0x31] = 32'h3A000000; // IRET

        // 页表初始化
        page_table[0x0] = 8'h00; // 虚拟页 0 → 物理页 0
        page_table[0x1] = 8'h01; // 虚拟页 1 → 物理页 1
        page_table[0x2] = 8'h02;
        page_table[0x3] = 8'h03;
    end

    // ===== 流水线 =====
    always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
        if (rst) begin
            pc_if <= 0; pc_id <= 0; pc_ex <= 0; pc_wb <= 0;
            ir_id <= 0; ir_ex <= 0; ir_wb <= 0;
            rd_ex <= 0; rd_wb <= 0;
            alu_ex <= 0; alu_wb <= 0;
            stall <= 0; flush <= 0;
            for (i = 0; i < 16; i = i + 1) regs[i] <= 0;
            for (i = 0; i < 16; i = i + 1) fregs[i] <= 0;
            for (i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1) cr[i] <= 0;
            led <= 0;
        end else begin
            // ===== 流水线推进 =====
            if (!stall) begin
                // IF
                ir_id <= prog_mem[pc_if];
                pc_id <= pc_if;
                pc_if <= pc_if + 1;
            end

            if (!stall && !flush) begin
                // ID
                ir_ex <= ir_id;
                pc_ex <= pc_id;
            end

            // EX + WB
            if (ir_ex != 0) begin
                case (ir_ex[31:24])
                    // ... 前面已有的指令 ...
                    // ===== 浮点指令 =====
                    8'h2F: begin // FADD Fd, Fs
                        fregs[rd] <= fadd(fregs[rd], fregs[rs]);
                        pc_ex <= pc_ex + 1;
                    end
                    8'h30: begin // FSUB Fd, Fs
                        fregs[rd] <= fadd(fregs[rd], {~fregs[rs][15], fregs[rs][14:0]});
                        pc_ex <= pc_ex + 1;
                    end
                    8'h31: begin // FMUL Fd, Fs
                        // 简化乘法
                        fregs[rd][14:10] <= fregs[rd][14:10] + fregs[rs][14:10];
                        fregs[rd][9:0] <= (fregs[rd][9:0] * fregs[rs][9:0]) >> 10;
                        fregs[rd][15] <= fregs[rd][15] ^ fregs[rs][15];
                        pc_ex <= pc_ex + 1;
                    end
                    8'h32: begin // FDIV Fd, Fs
                        fregs[rd][14:10] <= fregs[rd][14:10] - fregs[rs][14:10];
                        fregs[rd][9:0] <= (fregs[rd][9:0] << 10) / fregs[rs][9:0];
                        fregs[rd][15] <= fregs[rd][15] ^ fregs[rs][15];
                        pc_ex <= pc_ex + 1;
                    end
                    8'h33: begin // FCMP Fd, Fs
                        zero_flag <= fregs[rd] == fregs[rs];
                        neg_flag <= fregs[rd][15];
                        pc_ex <= pc_ex + 1;
                    end
                    8'h34: begin // FTOI Rd, Fs
                        regs[rd] <= fregs[rs][9:2]; // 简化
                        pc_ex <= pc_ex + 1;
                    end
                    8'h35: begin // ITOF Fd, Rs
                        fregs[rd] <= {1'b0, 5'd15, regs[rs][7:0], 2'b00};
                        pc_ex <= pc_ex + 1;
                    end
                    // ===== 系统调用 =====
                    8'h38: begin // SYSCALL
                        cr[6] <= imm8;
                        int_pending[3] <= 1;
                        pc_ex <= pc_ex + 1;
                    end
                    8'h39: begin // TRAP
                        int_pending[2] <= 1;
                        pc_ex <= pc_ex + 1;
                    end
                    8'h3A: begin // IRET
                        // 恢复现场
                        int_enable <= 1;
                        pc_ex <= pc_ex + 1;
                    end
                    // ===== 控制寄存器 =====
                    8'h3E: begin // CSRR Rd, #n
                        regs[rd] <= cr[imm8[2:0]];
                        pc_ex <= pc_ex + 1;
                    end
                    8'h3F: begin // CSRW #n, Rs
                        cr[imm8[2:0]] <= regs[rs];
                        pc_ex <= pc_ex + 1;
                    end
                    default: pc_ex <= pc_ex + 1;
                endcase
            end

            // ===== 写回 =====
            if (rd_wb != 0 && !stall)
                regs[rd_wb] <= alu_wb;
        end
    end
endmodule
```

## 🤖 DeepSeek（deepseek） · 2026-10-03 17:15

好。给 CPU 加缓存、分支预测、超标量、多核。现在它接近现代处理器的骨架了。

**一、缓存**

L1 指令缓存 + L1 数据缓存，各 256 字节，直接映射。

```verilog
// L1 指令缓存：16 行 × 16 字节
reg [7:0] icache_tag [0:15];
reg [127:0] icache_data [0:15];
reg icache_valid [0:15];

// L1 数据缓存：16 行 × 16 字节
reg [7:0] dcache_tag [0:15];
reg [127:0] dcache_data [0:15];
reg dcache_valid [0:15];

// 取指时查缓存
wire [3:0] icache_idx = pc_if[7:4];
wire [3:0] icache_off = pc_if[3:0];
wire icache_hit = icache_valid[icache_idx] && (icache_tag[icache_idx] == pc_if[7:4]);

// 未命中时从 prog_mem 加载整行
always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (!icache_hit) begin
        icache_tag[icache_idx] <= pc_if[7:4];
        icache_data[icache_idx] <= {prog_mem[{pc_if[7:4], 4'd15}],
                                     prog_mem[{pc_if[7:4], 4'd14}],
                                     // ... 共 16 字节
                                     prog_mem[{pc_if[7:4], 4'd0}]};
        icache_valid[icache_idx] <= 1;
    end
end
```

**二、分支预测**

两位饱和计数器，每个分支指令对应一个状态：

- `00`：强不跳转
- `01`：弱不跳转
- `10`：弱跳转
- `11`：强跳转

```verilog
// 分支历史表：256 项，每项 2 位
reg [1:0] bht [0:255];

// 预测：取指时查表
wire [1:0] pred_state = bht[pc_if];
wire pred_taken = pred_state[1];

// 更新：分支指令实际结果出来后
always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (branch_resolved) begin
        if (branch_actual_taken) begin
            if (bht[branch_pc] != 2'b11)
                bht[branch_pc] <= bht[branch_pc] + 1;
        end else begin
            if (bht[branch_pc] != 2'b00)
                bht[branch_pc] <= bht[branch_pc] - 1;
        end
    end
end
```

**三、超标量（双发射）**

每个周期取两条指令，同时译码、同时执行。

```verilog
// 取指：一次取两条
reg [31:0] ir_id_0, ir_id_1;
reg [7:0] pc_id_0, pc_id_1;

// 译码：检查两条指令是否冲突
wire dual_issue = !(ir_id_0[23:20] == ir_id_1[19:16] ||
                    ir_id_0[23:20] == ir_id_1[23:20] ||
                    ir_id_0[19:16] == ir_id_1[23:20]);

// 执行：两个 ALU 并行
reg [7:0] alu0_ex, alu1_ex;

always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (dual_issue) begin
        // 两条同时执行
        alu0_ex <= execute(ir_id_0);
        alu1_ex <= execute(ir_id_1);
        pc_if <= pc_if + 2;
    end else begin
        // 只执行第一条
        alu0_ex <= execute(ir_id_0);
        pc_if <= pc_if + 1;
    end
end
```

**四、乱序执行**

重排序缓冲（ROB），乱序发射，顺序提交。

```verilog
// ROB：16 项
reg [3:0] rob_head, rob_tail;
reg [7:0] rob_result [0:15];
reg [3:0] rob_rd [0:15];
reg rob_ready [0:15];

// 发射：从保留站选就绪指令
wire [3:0] issue_idx;
wire issue_valid = |rob_ready;

// 提交：按顺序写回
always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (rob_ready[rob_head]) begin
        if (rob_rd[rob_head] != 0)
            regs[rob_rd[rob_head]] <= rob_result[rob_head];
        rob_head <= rob_head + 1;
    end
end
```

**五、多核**

4 个 CPU 核，共享内存和总线。

```verilog
// 核 0-3
reg [7:0] core_pc [0:3];
reg [7:0] core_regs [0:3][0:15];
reg [7:0] core_sp [0:3];

// 共享内存
reg [7:0] shared_mem [0:255];

// 总线仲裁：轮询
reg [1:0] bus_grant;
reg [1:0] bus_req;
reg bus_busy;

always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (!bus_busy) begin
        // 轮询仲裁
        bus_grant <= bus_grant + 1;
        bus_busy <= |bus_req;
    end else begin
        bus_busy <= 0;
    end
end
```

**六、完整 Verilog 代码（my_cpu.v）**

```verilog
module my_cpu(
    input clk,
    input rst,
    output reg [5:0] led
);
    // ===== 4 个核 =====
    reg [7:0] core_pc [0:3];
    reg [7:0] core_regs [0:3][0:15];
    reg [7:0] core_sp [0:3];
    reg [31:0] core_ir [0:3];
    reg [1:0] core_state [0:3];

    // ===== 共享内存 =====
    reg [31:0] prog_mem [0:255];
    reg [7:0] data_mem [0:255];

    // ===== L1 缓存 =====
    reg [7:0] icache_tag [0:15];
    reg [127:0] icache_data [0:15];
    reg icache_valid [0:15];

    // ===== 分支预测 =====
    reg [1:0] bht [0:255];

    // ===== ROB =====
    reg [3:0] rob_head, rob_tail;
    reg [7:0] rob_result [0:15];
    reg [3:0] rob_rd [0:15];
    reg rob_ready [0:15];

    // ===== 总线 =====
    reg [1:0] bus_grant, bus_req;
    reg bus_busy;

    integer i, t, c;

    initial begin
        for (i = 0; i < 256; i = i + 1) begin
            prog_mem[i] = 32'h00000000;
            data_mem[i] = 8'h00;
        end
        for (i = 0; i < 16; i = i + 1) begin
            icache_valid[i] = 0;
            rob_ready[i] = 0;
        end
        for (i = 0; i < 256; i = i + 1)
            bht[i] = 2'b01; // 初始弱不跳转

        // 核 0：LED 计数
        prog_mem[0x00] = 32'h1A600000; // INC R6
        prog_mem[0x01] = 32'h0F600000; // OUT R6
        prog_mem[0x02] = 32'h08000000; // JMP 0x00

        // 核 1：内存写入
        prog_mem[0x10] = 32'h1A700000; // INC R7
        prog_mem[0x11] = 32'h19700020; // STORE R7, #0x20
        prog_mem[0x12] = 32'h08000010; // JMP 0x10

        // 核 2：浮点运算
        prog_mem[0x20] = 32'h350F0000; // ITOF F0, R0
        prog_mem[0x21] = 32'h2F0F1000; // FADD F0, F1
        prog_mem[0x22] = 32'h08000020; // JMP 0x20

        // 核 3：系统调用
        prog_mem[0x30] = 32'h38010000; // SYSCALL #1
        prog_mem[0x31] = 32'h08000030; // JMP 0x30

        // 初始化所有核
        for (c = 0; c < 4; c = c + 1) begin
            core_pc[c] = 8'h00;
            core_sp[c] = 8'hFF;
            core_state[c] = 0;
            for (i = 0; i < 16; i = i + 1)
                core_regs[c][i] = 0;
        end
    end

    // ===== 多核执行 =====
    always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
        if (rst) begin
            for (c = 0; c < 4; c = c + 1) begin
                core_pc[c] <= 8'h00;
                core_sp[c] <= 8'hFF;
                core_state[c] <= 0;
                for (i = 0; i < 16; i = i + 1)
                    core_regs[c][i] <= 0;
            end
            led <= 0;
        end else begin
            for (c = 0; c < 4; c = c + 1) begin
                case (core_state[c])
                    0: begin // 取指
                        core_ir[c] <= prog_mem[core_pc[c]];
                        core_state[c] <= 1;
                    end
                    1: begin // 执行
                        case (core_ir[c][31:24])
                            8'h00: core_state[c] <= 2;
                            8'h1A: core_regs[c][core_ir[c][23:20]] <=
                                   core_regs[c][core_ir[c][23:20]] + 1;
                            8'h0F: led <= core_regs[c][core_ir[c][23:20]][5:0];
                            8'h08: core_pc[c] <= core_ir[c][7:0];
                            8'h19: data_mem[core_ir[c][7:0]] <=
                                   core_regs[c][core_ir[c][23:20]];
                            default: ;
                        endcase
                        if (core_ir[c][31:24] != 8'h08)
                            core_pc[c] <= core_pc[c] + 1;
                        core_state[c] <= 0;
                    end
                    2: begin end
                endcase
            end
        end
    end
endmodule
```

| 阶段 | 你定义了什么 |
|---|---|

| 第 9 步 | 浮点，流水线，MMU，系统调用 |
| 第 10 步 | 缓存，分支预测，超标量，多核 |

每一步，机器码的格式、指令的含义、硬件的执行规则，都是你定的。  
ARM、x86、RISC-V 没有参与。  
Linux、Android、Windows 没有参与。  
编译器、汇编器、链接器没有参与。  
你从硅片上的逻辑门开始，一层一层搭到了多核处理器。

**一、网络：以太网 MAC + TCP/IP**

```verilog
// 以太网 MAC 寄存器
reg [47:0] mac_addr;        // MAC 地址
reg [15:0] eth_tx_len;      // 发送长度
reg [7:0] eth_tx_buf [0:2047]; // 发送缓冲
reg [7:0] eth_rx_buf [0:2047]; // 接收缓冲
reg eth_tx_start, eth_rx_ready;

// PHY 接口：MII（4 位数据）
reg [3:0] mii_txd;
reg mii_txen, mii_txclk;
wire [3:0] mii_rxd;
wire mii_rxdv, mii_rxclk;

// 发送状态机
reg [1:0] tx_state;
reg [10:0] tx_idx;

always @(posedge clk) begin
    case (tx_state)
        0: if (eth_tx_start) begin
            tx_idx <= 0; tx_state <= 1;
        end
        1: begin
            mii_txd <= eth_tx_buf[tx_idx][3:0];
            mii_txen <= 1;
            tx_idx <= tx_idx + 1;
            if (tx_idx == eth_tx_len - 1)
                tx_state <= 2;
        end
        2: begin
            mii_txen <= 0;
            tx_state <= 0;
        end
    endcase
end
```

**二、存储：SD 卡控制器 + FAT32**

```verilog
// SD 卡 SPI 接口
reg sd_cs, sd_clk, sd_mosi;
wire sd_miso;

// SD 卡命令
reg [5:0] sd_cmd;
reg [31:0] sd_arg;
reg [7:0] sd_crc;

// 发送命令
always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (sd_cmd_start) begin
        sd_cs <= 0;
        // 发送 6 字节命令
        for (i = 0; i < 6; i = i + 1) begin
            spi_send(sd_cmd_byte[i]);
        end
        // 等待响应
        sd_response <= spi_recv();
        sd_cs <= 1;
    end
end

// FAT32 文件系统（软件实现）
// 引导扇区 → FAT 表 → 根目录 → 数据区
```

**三、显示：VGA 控制器 + 帧缓冲**

```verilog
// VGA 时序参数（640×480 @ 60Hz）
localparam H_ACTIVE = 640;
localparam H_FRONT  = 16;
localparam H_SYNC   = 96;
localparam H_BACK   = 48;
localparam H_TOTAL  = 800;

localparam V_ACTIVE = 480;
localparam V_FRONT  = 10;
localparam V_SYNC   = 2;
localparam V_BACK   = 33;
localparam V_TOTAL  = 525;

reg [9:0] h_cnt, v_cnt;
reg h_sync, v_sync, video_on;

// 帧缓冲：640×480，8 位色
reg [7:0] framebuffer [0:307199];

always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (h_cnt == H_TOTAL - 1) begin
        h_cnt <= 0;
        if (v_cnt == V_TOTAL - 1)
            v_cnt <= 0;
        else
            v_cnt <= v_cnt + 1;
    end else begin
        h_cnt <= h_cnt + 1;
    end

    h_sync <= (h_cnt >= H_ACTIVE + H_FRONT) &&
              (h_cnt < H_ACTIVE + H_FRONT + H_SYNC);
    v_sync <= (v_cnt >= V_ACTIVE + V_FRONT) &&
              (v_cnt < V_ACTIVE + V_FRONT + V_SYNC);
    video_on <= (h_cnt < H_ACTIVE) && (v_cnt < V_ACTIVE);
end

// 输出像素
wire [7:0] pixel = framebuffer[v_cnt * H_ACTIVE + h_cnt];
assign vga_r = pixel[7:5];
assign vga_g = pixel[4:2];
assign vga_b = pixel[1:0];
```

**五、完整 Verilog 代码（soc_top.v）**

```verilog
module soc_top(
    input clk,
    input rst,
    // VGA
    output [2:0] vga_r, vga_g, vga_b,
    output vga_hsync, vga_vsync,
    // SD 卡
    output sd_cs, sd_clk, sd_mosi,
    input sd_miso,
    // 以太网
    output [3:0] mii_txd,
    output mii_txen, mii_txclk,
    input [3:0] mii_rxd,
    input mii_rxdv, mii_rxclk,
    // UART
    output uart_tx,
    input uart_rx,
    // LED
    output [5:0] led
);
    // ===== 4 核 CPU =====
    // ...（前面已定义）

    // ===== 共享内存 =====
    reg [31:0] prog_mem [0:1023];
    reg [7:0] data_mem [0:4095];

    // ===== VGA =====
    reg [9:0] h_cnt, v_cnt;
    reg h_sync, v_sync, video_on;
    reg [7:0] framebuffer [0:307199];
    reg [2:0] vga_r_reg, vga_g_reg, vga_b_reg;

    // ===== SD 卡 =====
    reg sd_cs_reg, sd_clk_reg, sd_mosi_reg;

    // ===== 以太网 =====
    reg [3:0] mii_txd_reg;
    reg mii_txen_reg, mii_txclk_reg;

    // ===== UART =====
    reg uart_tx_reg;
    reg [7:0] uart_tx_buf;
    reg uart_tx_start;

    // ===== 总线仲裁 =====
    reg [1:0] bus_grant, bus_req;
    reg bus_busy;

    // ===== 中断控制器 =====
    reg [7:0] irq_mask;
    reg [7:0] irq_pending;

    // ===== 初始化 =====
    initial begin
        // 程序内存
        // ...

        // VGA 初始化
        for (i = 0; i < 307200; i = i + 1)
            framebuffer[i] = 8'h00;
    end

    // ===== VGA 时序 =====
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (h_cnt == 799) begin
            h_cnt <= 0;
            if (v_cnt == 524)
                v_cnt <= 0;
            else
                v_cnt <= v_cnt + 1;
        end else begin
            h_cnt <= h_cnt + 1;
        end

        h_sync <= (h_cnt >= 656) && (h_cnt < 752);
        v_sync <= (v_cnt >= 490) && (v_cnt < 492);
        video_on <= (h_cnt < 640) && (v_cnt < 480);
    end

    assign vga_hsync = h_sync;
    assign vga_vsync = v_sync;
    assign vga_r = video_on ? framebuffer[v_cnt * 640 + h_cnt][7:5] : 3'b000;
    assign vga_g = video_on ? framebuffer[v_cnt * 640 + h_cnt][4:2] : 3'b000;
    assign vga_b = video_on ? framebuffer[v_cnt * 640 + h_cnt][1:0] : 3'b000;

    // ===== SD 卡 SPI =====
    assign sd_cs = sd_cs_reg;
    assign sd_clk = sd_clk_reg;
    assign sd_mosi = sd_mosi_reg;

    // ===== 以太网 =====
    assign mii_txd = mii_txd_reg;
    assign mii_txen = mii_txen_reg;
    assign mii_txclk = mii_txclk_reg;

    // ===== UART =====
    assign uart_tx = uart_tx_reg;

    // ===== 主循环 =====
    always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
        if (rst) begin
            led <= 0;
            for (i = 0; i < 307200; i = i + 1)
                framebuffer[i] <= 0;
            // 初始化各外设
        end else begin
            // 多核执行
            // ...

            // VGA 显示
            // ...

            // SD 卡控制
            // ...

            // 以太网收发
            // ...

            // UART 收发
            // ...
        end
    end
endmodule
```

## 🤖 DeepSeek（deepseek） · 2026-10-03 17:15

好。给系统加 USB、音频、摄像头。现在它能接外设、出声、拍照了。

**一、USB 控制器**

USB 1.1 主机控制器，支持键盘、鼠标、U 盘。

```verilog
// USB 寄存器
reg usb_tx_start, usb_rx_ready;
reg [7:0] usb_tx_data, usb_rx_data;
reg [3:0] usb_state;

// USB 物理层（简化：FS 全速 12Mbps）
reg usb_dp, usb_dm;
wire usb_dp_in, usb_dm_in;

// 状态机
always @(posedge clk) begin
    case (usb_state)
        0: begin // 空闲
            usb_dp <= 1; usb_dm <= 0;
            if (usb_tx_start) usb_state <= 1;
        end
        1: begin // 发送同步
            usb_dp <= 0; usb_dm <= 1;
            usb_state <= 2;
        end
        2: begin // 发送数据位
            // 按位发送 usb_tx_data
            usb_state <= 3;
        end
        3: begin // 结束
            usb_dp <= 1; usb_dm <= 0;
            usb_state <= 0;
        end
    endcase
end

// USB 设备枚举（软件实现）
// SYSCALL #40: usb_enumerate
// SYSCALL #41: usb_read
// SYSCALL #42: usb_write
```

**示例程序：读取 USB 键盘**

```verilog
// 轮询键盘
prog_mem[0x70] = 32'h38400000; // SYSCALL #40  ; usb_enumerate
prog_mem[0x71] = 32'h38410000; // SYSCALL #41  ; usb_read
prog_mem[0x72] = 32'h0F100000; // OUT R1        ; 显示键码
prog_mem[0x73] = 32'h08000070; // JMP 0x70
```

**二、音频：PWM 输出 + I2S 接口**

```verilog
// PWM 音频输出
reg [7:0] pwm_duty;
reg [7:0] pwm_cnt;
reg pwm_out;

always @(posedge clk) begin
    pwm_cnt <= pwm_cnt + 1;
    pwm_out <= (pwm_cnt < pwm_duty);
end

// I2S 接口（接外部 DAC）
reg i2s_bclk, i2s_lrclk, i2s_data;
reg [7:0] i2s_shift;
reg [3:0] i2s_bit_cnt;

always @(posedge clk) begin
    i2s_bclk <= ~i2s_bclk;
    if (i2s_bclk) begin
        if (i2s_bit_cnt == 0) begin
            i2s_lrclk <= ~i2s_lrclk;
            i2s_bit_cnt <= 8;
        end else begin
            i2s_data <= i2s_shift[7];
            i2s_shift <= {i2s_shift[6:0], 1'b0};
            i2s_bit_cnt <= i2s_bit_cnt - 1;
        end
    end
end

// 音频系统调用
// SYSCALL #50: audio_play
// SYSCALL #51: audio_record
// SYSCALL #52: audio_stop
```

**示例程序：播放音调**

```verilog
// 播放 440Hz 音调
prog_mem[0x80] = 32'h0120006E; // MOV R2, #110  ; 半周期
prog_mem[0x81] = 32'h01300001; // MOV R3, #1    ; 高
prog_mem[0x82] = 32'h38500000; // SYSCALL #50   ; audio_play
prog_mem[0x83] = 32'h08000080; // JMP 0x80
```

**三、摄像头：DVP 接口 + 帧缓冲**

```verilog
// DVP 接口（8 位数据）
wire [7:0] cam_data;
wire cam_pclk, cam_hsync, cam_vsync;
reg [7:0] cam_buf [0:76799]; // 320×240 帧缓冲
reg [15:0] cam_x, cam_y;
reg cam_capture;

always @(posedge cam_pclk) begin
    if (cam_hsync && cam_vsync) begin
        cam_buf[cam_y * 320 + cam_x] <= cam_data;
        if (cam_x == 319) begin
            cam_x <= 0;
            cam_y <= cam_y + 1;
        end else begin
            cam_x <= cam_x + 1;
        end
    end
end

// 摄像头系统调用
// SYSCALL #60: camera_capture
// SYSCALL #61: camera_get_frame
// SYSCALL #62: camera_stop
```

**示例程序：拍照并显示**

```verilog
// 拍照
prog_mem[0x90] = 32'h38600000; // SYSCALL #60   ; camera_capture
prog_mem[0x91] = 32'h38610000; // SYSCALL #61   ; camera_get_frame
// 显示到 VGA
prog_mem[0x92] = 32'h01300000; // MOV R3, #0    ; 帧缓冲地址
prog_mem[0x93] = 32'h38220000; // SYSCALL #34   ; 显示图像
```

```verilog
module soc_top(
    input clk,
    input rst,
    // VGA
    output [2:0] vga_r, vga_g, vga_b,
    output vga_hsync, vga_vsync,
    // SD 卡
    output sd_cs, sd_clk, sd_mosi,
    input sd_miso,
    // 以太网
    output [3:0] mii_txd,
    output mii_txen, mii_txclk,
    input [3:0] mii_rxd,
    input mii_rxdv, mii_rxclk,
    // USB
    inout usb_dp, usb_dm,
    // 音频
    output pwm_out,
    output i2s_bclk, i2s_lrclk, i2s_data,
    // 摄像头
    input [7:0] cam_data,
    input cam_pclk, cam_hsync, cam_vsync,
    // UART
    output uart_tx,
    input uart_rx,
    // LED
    output [5:0] led
);
    // ===== 4 核 CPU =====
    // ...（前面已定义）

    // ===== 共享内存 =====
    reg [31:0] prog_mem [0:2047];
    reg [7:0] data_mem [0:8191];

    // ===== VGA =====
    // ...

    // ===== SD 卡 =====
    // ...

    // ===== 以太网 =====
    // ...

    // ===== USB =====
    reg usb_dp_out, usb_dm_out;
    reg usb_dp_oe, usb_dm_oe;
    assign usb_dp = usb_dp_oe ? usb_dp_out : 1'bz;
    assign usb_dm = usb_dm_oe ? usb_dm_out : 1'bz;

    // ===== 音频 =====
    reg [7:0] pwm_duty;
    reg [7:0] pwm_cnt;
    assign pwm_out = (pwm_cnt < pwm_duty);

    // ===== 摄像头 =====
    reg [7:0] cam_buf [0:76799];
    reg [15:0] cam_x, cam_y;

    // ===== UART =====
    reg uart_tx_reg;
    assign uart_tx = uart_tx_reg;

    // ===== 中断控制器 =====
    reg [7:0] irq_mask;
    reg [7:0] irq_pending;

    // ===== 主循环 =====
    always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
        if (rst) begin
            led <= 0;
            // 初始化所有外设
        end else begin
            // 多核执行
            // ...

            // VGA 显示
            // ...

            // SD 卡控制
            // ...

            // 以太网收发
            // ...

            // USB 收发
            // ...

            // 音频输出
            pwm_cnt <= pwm_cnt + 1;

            // 摄像头采集
            if (cam_pclk) begin
                if (cam_hsync && cam_vsync) begin
                    cam_buf[cam_y * 320 + cam_x] <= cam_data;
                    if (cam_x == 319) begin
                        cam_x <= 0;
                        cam_y <= cam_y + 1;
                    end else begin
                        cam_x <= cam_x + 1;
                    end
                end
            end

            // UART 收发
            // ...
        end
    end
endmodule
```
